description: All bytes are 0x-hex, lower case; uint values are JSON numbers. Generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/pqchat-vectors.mjs (src/pqchat.js); never edit by hand. Random inputs are fixed: rnd(name, n) = the first n bytes of keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/0") ‖ keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/1") ‖ …; the labels are in the generator. Source: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-23-pqchat-treekem.md (§4 the tree, §5 treeId and genesisCtx, §6 records, §8 the admission check and a commit's order), plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-23-pqchat-treekem.md T1a. UNAUDITED. A tree: nodes[x] is null (blank), a leaf {ua, keyId, kemHash} (node 2i is leaf i) or a parent {keyHash}; nodeHashes[x] = th(x); goneUa, goneOwnKey (the pairs) and goneKey (session-wide) are the no-return sets (C28, owner R14, R16). treeMath: RFC 9420's tree-math vectors (mlswg/mls-implementations test-vectors/tree-math.json at e4d3b074f3452a6fa3a7681ede6c963c410aafd9) regenerated by our tree math: JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2) has that file's sha256. resolution: per tree the resolution of every node, the filtered path, ctTargets and the target (index into ctTargets) that covers each live leaf for each author. treeHash: cold trees; commits applied in the contract's order (Removes, Adds, gone after the Adds, the path, th along every changed path), each from the tree named by before; refusals with the named error; twins accepted. admission: refused keys (error names the check; every one is PqChatKemKey in the contract) each with its accepted twin, accepted keys, and related: torsion-shifted keys (fable-r3-2, R15). digests: struct hashes, typed = keccak256(0x1901 ‖ DS_C ‖ structHash) and signedDigest = uaMessage(0x0131 mldsa65, PURPOSE_PQCHAT, typed) of the signed records. noReturn (R16): scenarios from a cold tree, each step a commit or a treeLeave / treeRemove mark (leave) with the tree and its sets after it, and probes: an Add commit on that tree with its verdict (accepted or the named error). people: the mldsa65 UAs (pqKeygen of rnd(tree/mldsa65-bip39-seed, 64), account 0, index) and public keys, named A … J in the order of their UAs, so every session here, listed by name, is strictly sorted by (ua, keyId) as the contract requires; the members' KEM keys are real.

pk_X = 9 + p (an accepted point plus p, where it fits below 2^255)

related.note: What the check does not give (R15): the base key's pk_X moved by a torsion point is admitted and has its own kemHash, yet every clamped X25519 scalar (ephemeral below) gives it the base key's output, so the holder of the base key's secret opens what is sealed to it. liveKey and goneKey mean the same bytes, never one capability per kemHash.

noReturn.name: the burn by own-key churn
noReturn.note: B registers A's next public key as its own version, adds it by a plain commit and takes it out: only (B, kemHash) is set

steps.name: B adds a copy of A2 as its keyId 12
B takes it out

probes.name: B adds it again as keyId 13

noReturn.name: the front-running loop
noReturn.note: B repeats the churn on each of A's next keys before A's Add: every Add of A is accepted; a copy B keeps live blocks A until an admin removes that leaf while B keeps another (a pair then)
